description: This file defines the class BasicSearchEngine within the SuiteCRM system, responsible for performing full-text search operations across multiple modules. It includes methods for executing searches, constructing query conditions, and handling search-related data retrieval.

classes.name: BasicSearchEngine
classes.description: A search engine class that extends the SearchEngine base class, implementing full-text search functionality across modules and handling search form integration.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Executes a search based on a SearchQuery object, measuring execution time and returning SearchResults.

methods.name: searchModules
methods.description: Performs the core logic of querying specified modules with the search string, applying filters, inner joins, and preparing results.

methods.name: buildFilterFields
methods.description: Builds the list of filter fields for list view data search based on the bean's field definitions.
